_comment: Godsfall card data. Faction: Hel (Toll subfaction) plus the 38 neutral support/tool/tower-support cards. See hel.md and support.md for design rationale.

_schema.name: display name
_schema.faction: hel | void | gaia | heaven | fire | neutral
_schema.retreat: attached energy spent to return this unit to hand (unit only). HP / 25 rounded down, same formula as toll, adjusted per card. See hel.md table.
_schema.evolves_from: card id this evolves from, or null
_schema.attacks: array of line objects (unit only). A line is an ATTACK by default: it is queued in the main phase, resolves at end of turn, and its 'cost' is pulled from the pool onto the unit, where it stays. Set "ability": true to make it an ABILITY instead: it resolves immediately when activated, is limited to once per turn per unit, and is FREE - 'cost' is ignored entirely. The only cost an ability may carry is "consume": N, which DESTROYS N attached energy on use. 'consume' is also legal on an attack.
_schema.effects: array of effect objects (support, tool, tower_support). Tools attach to a unit, one per unit, discarded when it dies or retreats. tower_support targets a tower you control; permanent ones are limited to one per tower and are lost when it dies.
_schema.permanent: tower_support only: true if it occupies the tower's one modification slot, false for one-shots

cards.flavor: Flexible early body.

cards.name: Gnawgrub

cards.name: Gristbarrow

attacks.name: Consume the Fallen

cards.name: Ossgaunt

attacks.name: Final Verdict

cards.name: Mormire

cards.name: Sepulshroud

cards.name: Nithogg, Root-Gnawer
cards.flavor: The Decay is what you're paying for.

cards.name: Cairnmaw

attacks.name: Surge of the Drowned
attacks.text: 40 to the opposing unit and 40 to the enemy tower

cards.flavor: Hel's tower-breaker. 6 energy and two bodies from one card.

cards.name: Hel, Queen of the Unclaimed

attacks.name: Claim the Fallen
attacks.text: Consume 2: return up to 2 Hel units from your discard directly to empty slots

attacks.name: THE LAST TOLL
attacks.text: Destroy every unit on both boards. Deal 15 to the enemy throne per unit destroyed. Your Tolls trigger as normal.

cards.flavor: The faction's win condition. She has no Toll of her own.

cards.name: Nithogg Ascendant

attacks.name: Endless Hunger
attacks.text: 40 to the opposing unit, 40 to the enemy tower; gain 5 energy

cards.flavor: 25 free damage per turn is a lane that cannot be held.

cards.name: Mordrung

attacks.name: Requiem
attacks.text: 45 damage; end-of-turn effects trigger three times this turn

cards.flavor: The build-around payoff.

cards.name: Gravekeeper's Ledger
cards.text: Draw 3 cards.
cards.flavor: The band-defining card. Everything else is priced against it.

cards.name: Scavenger's Instinct
cards.text: Look at the top 5 cards of your deck. Take 2 into your hand. Discard the rest.
cards.flavor: Fewer cards than Ledger, but you choose them - and the 3 discarded are live for Hel.

cards.name: Second Thoughts
cards.text: Shuffle your hand into your deck, then draw that many cards plus 1.
cards.flavor: The reset. The only answer to a hand flooded with locked retreat cards.

cards.name: Last Rites
cards.text: Discard 2 cards. Draw 4.
cards.flavor: Same net +1 as Second Thoughts, but you pick what goes.

cards.name: Muster
cards.text: Search your deck for a Basic unit and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck.
cards.flavor: The card that fixes the worst opening hands. Pure consistency.

cards.name: Roll Call
cards.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic units, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck.
cards.flavor: Rebuilds a board in one play - the answer to THE LAST TOLL.

cards.name: Line of Succession
cards.text: Reveal a random Stage 1 or Stage 2 unit from your deck and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck.
cards.flavor: Random on purpose: a deckbuilding card rather than a tutor.

cards.name: Read the Bones
cards.text: Search your deck for any one card and put it on top of your deck. Shuffle your deck first.
cards.flavor: The one true tutor. A full turn of delay is what keeps it in band.

cards.name: Grave Market
cards.text: Put a random card from your discard pile into your hand.
cards.flavor: Gets worse as it gets more powerful - a shape the file needed.

cards.name: Offering
cards.text: Gain 3 energy of any single color to your pool.
cards.flavor: Goes to the pool, so it is exposed to decay. Not an energy card.

cards.name: Tithe
cards.text: Move all attached energy from one of your units to another of your units.
cards.flavor: Makes charging the wrong unit recoverable.

cards.name: Sift the Ashes
cards.text: Gain 1 energy for each of your units that died this turn, to a maximum of 4.
cards.flavor: A catch-up card by construction: dead when you are ahead.

cards.name: Escape Route
cards.text: Retreat one of your units at no cost. Its leftover attached energy still returns to your pool.
cards.flavor: The clean answer to a Stage 2 you cannot afford to extract.

cards.name: Withdraw
cards.text: Retreat one of your units. Its retreat cost is paid from your pool instead of its attached energy.
cards.flavor: The only way to move a unit with no attached energy.

cards.name: Rally the Line
cards.text: Units that returned to your hand this turn are no longer locked. You may play them this turn.
cards.flavor: Explicitly a rule-breaker. Turns retreat into a real reposition.

cards.name: Ground Give
cards.text: Return one of your units to your hand. It is locked as normal, and its attached energy is lost.
cards.flavor: Retreat for units that cannot pay. The energy loss is the price.

cards.name: Reposition
cards.text: Move an enemy unit to another slot on its own board. It keeps all attached energy.
cards.flavor: An unnamed attack hits the slot across, so a body shoved sideways is a board that aims somewhere else.

cards.name: Shore Up
cards.text: Heal one of your units 20 HP.
cards.flavor: The baseline every other heal is priced against.

cards.name: Field Rites
cards.text: Heal each of your units 10 HP.
cards.flavor: Its real use is against Decay, which hits everything for small amounts.

cards.name: Last Breath
cards.text: Heal one of your units 50 HP. It must be at or below half its printed HP.
cards.flavor: Dead in hand when you are not under pressure. A flat number, not a reset.

cards.name: Reconsecrate
cards.text: Heal one of your units 20 HP and remove all Decay damage dealt to it this turn.
cards.flavor: The narrow answer to Hel's identity keyword, printed as neutral on purpose.

cards.name: Hold the Slot
cards.text: Until the end of the turn, one of your units cannot be reduced below 1 HP.
cards.flavor: A unit saved this way does not Toll - it did not die.

cards.name: Mend
cards.text: Heal one of your units 10 HP.
cards.flavor: One round of early tower fire. The bottom rung of the ladder.

cards.name: Field Surgery
cards.text: Heal one of your units 50 HP.
cards.flavor: One energy buys thirty more healing. The rate everything priced is checked against.

cards.name: Closing Ranks
cards.text: Heal each of your units 20 HP.
cards.flavor: Wants a wide board, not a dead one. Worthless on a single unit.

cards.name: Vigil
cards.text: Heal one of your units 15 HP for each round that has passed, counting the current one.
cards.flavor: Three times the tower's scaling. The only heal that grows.

cards.name: Grave Warden's Oath
cards.text: Heal one of your units 100 HP.
cards.flavor: More than most bodies can hold. The overflow is the price of certainty.

cards.name: Collapse
cards.text: Deal 20 damage to an enemy unit that has no attached energy.
cards.flavor: Only ever kills chaff, never the unit someone invested in.

cards.name: Sever
cards.text: Destroy 2 attached energy on an enemy unit.
cards.flavor: The first anti-hoarding card. Void's version should be more interesting, not stronger.

cards.name: Toppling Blow
cards.text: Deal 25 damage to an enemy tower.
cards.flavor: Restricted to towers so it can never be a throne-burn plan.

cards.name: Watchfires
cards.text: Reveal cards from the top of your deck until you reveal a tower support card. Put it into your hand and shuffle the rest back.
cards.flavor: A plain support, not a tower support - it works with both towers dead.

cards.name: Bone Splint
cards.text: Attached unit heals 5 HP at end of turn.
cards.flavor: Five turns to match Shore Up. Excellent on a wall nobody attacks.

cards.name: Weighted Chain
cards.text: Attached unit's attacks deal 5 more damage.
cards.flavor: Small on purpose - it must never compete with paying for an attack.

cards.name: Grave Anchor
cards.text: Attached unit's retreat cost is reduced by 2, to a minimum of 0.
cards.flavor: Paid in advance for an escape you may never use, and discarded on the retreat it enables.

cards.name: Ration Pack
cards.text: At end of turn, move 1 energy from your pool to the attached unit.
cards.flavor: The only card that structurally answers pool decay. Flagged as possibly too strong.

cards.name: Iron Standard
cards.text: Attached unit has Retribution 5. This stacks with its printed Retribution.
cards.flavor: Grants the keyword that best punishes this game's economy.

cards.name: Deadweight
cards.text: Attach to an enemy unit. That unit's attacks cost 1 more energy.
cards.flavor: Also blocks their own Tools - a real second mode nobody notices until it matters.

cards.name: Reinforced Base
cards.text: Target tower gains +20 max HP.
cards.flavor: Max HP rather than a heal, so it stacks with the tower's own growth.

cards.name: Murder Holes
cards.text: Target tower deals +5 damage.
cards.flavor: Doubles a turn-1 tower and fades to noise by turn 10 - the right curve for a free card.

cards.name: Crossfire
cards.text: Target tower also fires for 5 damage at the other enemy board.
cards.flavor: The only thing in the game that lets a structure hit across boards.

cards.name: Rebuild
cards.text: Heal target tower 25 HP. It cannot be healed above its max HP.
cards.flavor: The cap is the important clause - uncapped tower healing is the stall engine.

cards.name: Spite Engine
cards.text: When target tower dies, deal 20 damage to the enemy unit in the slot facing it.
cards.flavor: Toll applied to structures - the investment pays out on the way down.

cards.name: Open the Gate
cards.text: Destroy your own target tower. Draw 2 cards.
cards.flavor: The anti-stall card. Opens the third slot on your schedule, not the opponent's.

cards.name: Heaven Energy
cards.text: Adds (turn + 1) Heaven energy to your pool.
cards.flavor: The light does not ration itself.

cards.name: Lumemote
cards.flavor: The smallest lamp still casts a verdict.

cards.name: Seraim
cards.flavor: A great second attack and a poor first one.

cards.name: Aurkin
cards.flavor: No judgment to pay for, so it pays full price and hits full weight.

cards.name: Belliel
cards.flavor: One line, two jobs - it can never execute and recharge in the same turn.

cards.name: Clarim
cards.flavor: A shield for the board behind it, not an attacker.

cards.name: Seravigil
cards.flavor: Turns every damaged unit on the board into a kill.

cards.name: Lumesear
cards.flavor: Kill it twice and it returns with its charge restored. The body is the payload.

cards.name: Bellchoir

attacks.name: Ring the Court Bell
attacks.text: Restore Judgment to every friendly unit whose printed card has Judgment.

cards.flavor: It carries no Judgment itself, so it cannot reset its own. That is the counterplay.

cards.name: Aurmant
cards.flavor: The hardest single hit in the faction, on the body hardest to kill.

cards.name: Seratribune

attacks.name: The Ledger Closes
attacks.text: Deal 15 damage to every enemy unit on one board.

cards.flavor: It does not kill a board. It pushes a board into range.

cards.name: Aurseraph

attacks.name: Rekindle
attacks.text: At end of turn, restore this unit's Sanctuary.

cards.flavor: Two hits in one turn, or it does not die at all.

cards.name: Lumearch
cards.flavor: It holds a lane forever. It does not win.

cards.name: Seraureole

attacks.name: The Gate Opens
attacks.text: Deal damage to the enemy throne equal to enemy units destroyed this turn x 15.

cards.flavor: The gate opens only as wide as the dead have made it.

cards.name: Aegis of the Choir
cards.text: Attach to a unit. That unit gains Sanctuary. If it already has Sanctuary, restore it instead.
cards.flavor: A one-shot investment on a body the opponent can kill.

cards.name: Nullith
cards.flavor: The cheapest theft in the game. Two energy for a body that pays itself back.

cards.name: Wanesk
cards.flavor: No text, standard curve. The control card that proves Void's rate cut is about its riders, not its color.

cards.name: Umbrith
cards.flavor: Pure ramp. A free Siphon every turn is the engine the aggressive build is designed around.

cards.name: Hushith

attacks.name: Unmake
attacks.text: 12 damage; Void 1. Deal 15 more for each energy destroyed this way.

cards.flavor: Zero against an empty body, 25 against a charged one. Void's whole thesis on one card.

cards.name: Sevwane
cards.flavor: Rift 1 on a Basic. Does nothing at Gap 0 and quietly becomes a real attack by turn 6.

cards.name: Scoursk
cards.flavor: An 85 HP Basic on the standard curve. Void's wall, and the body Siphon energy is safest on.

cards.name: Nullfray
cards.flavor: The workhorse. Siphon 1 every turn, forever, on a body that survives a volley.

cards.name: Sevgaunt
cards.flavor: Rift 1 at Stage 1. At Gap 12 this is a 34-damage attack that cost 3.

cards.name: Hushfray

attacks.name: Blank the Page
attacks.text: Consume 1: Void 2 on a target enemy unit.

cards.flavor: Destruction, not theft — it takes nothing back. Consume 1 is what stops a free repeating strip.

cards.name: Waneebb
cards.flavor: Siphon 2 is the ceiling. Four energy of swing per turn on a body that has to survive to do it.

cards.name: Scourebb
cards.flavor: No rider at all — the standard curve on Void's biggest Stage 1. The honest beater.

cards.name: Nullnought
cards.flavor: The only card holding both signatures. Siphon feeds its own Rift: every point stolen is two more damage next turn.

cards.name: Sevnull
cards.flavor: The single Rift 2 in the faction, deliberately. At Gap 20 it hits for 84 and that is the intended ceiling.

cards.name: Hushreave

attacks.name: Null the Pool
attacks.text: Consume 2: destroy 20% of the enemy POOL, minimum 2.

cards.flavor: The rule-breaker: the only card that reaches the pool. Worthless early, devastating against a hoarder.

cards.name: Wanesunder

attacks.name: The Long Quiet
attacks.text: 10 damage to the enemy throne for each point of Gap, to a maximum of 100.

cards.flavor: The win condition. It converts the Gap you built into throne damage, which is the only thing Rift cannot do.

cards.name: Void Energy
cards.text: Adds (turn + 1) Void energy to your pool.
cards.flavor: What is taken has to come from somewhere.

cards.name: Draw Down
cards.text: Siphon 1 from a target enemy unit.
cards.flavor: The free floor. Every Void deck runs four.

cards.name: Exsanguinate
cards.text: Siphon 3 from a target enemy unit.
cards.flavor: The priced variant: same effect, restriction removed. Two energy buys two more points.

cards.name: Unwrite
cards.text: Destroy all attached energy on a target enemy unit.
cards.flavor: Takes nothing back, so it is priced below theft. The answer to one over-charged body.

cards.name: Widening Rift
cards.text: Deal damage to a target enemy unit equal to twice the Gap, to a maximum of 30.
cards.flavor: Reach on a card, capped so it can never be the whole plan.

cards.name: Event Horizon
cards.text: Attach to a unit. That unit gains Rift 1.
cards.flavor: A Tool is a bet the body survives, which is exactly what a Rift unit needs to be.

cards.name: Gaia Energy
cards.text: Adds (turn + 1) Gaia energy to your pool.
cards.flavor: Everything green is a slow argument with stone.

cards.name: Petrisprout
cards.text: Fires at the unit across from it at end of turn, free. Gains +5 max HP each round.
cards.flavor: Stones remember the shape they were stacked in.

cards.name: Verdling
cards.text: Earth equal to its attached energy.
cards.flavor: What it drinks, the grove feels.

cards.name: Verdbough
cards.text: Earth grants +2 instead of +1.
cards.flavor: Down far enough, every stone is one stone.

cards.name: Petricrag
cards.text: Fires at the unit across from it at end of turn, free. Gains +5 max HP each round.
cards.flavor: They stopped hauling stone and started asking it to stay.

cards.name: Petrimonolith
cards.text: Fires at the unit across from it at end of turn, free. Gains +5 max HP each round.
cards.flavor: Older than the throne it outlasts.

cards.name: Verdheart
cards.text: Earth equal to its attached energy, in addition to its printed Earth.
cards.flavor: Every ring is a year the world did not end.

cards.name: Bryobud
cards.flavor: Small, and in no hurry.

cards.name: Bryowarden
cards.text: Once per turn: this unit gains +1 Earth permanently.
cards.flavor: Tending is just patience with a direction.

cards.name: Bryoelder
cards.text: Once per turn: this unit gains +1 Earth permanently.
cards.flavor: It remembers being the sapling. It is in no hurry still.

cards.name: Lichling
cards.flavor: Nothing it has ever met was worth hurrying for.

cards.name: Lichcrag
cards.flavor: The lane does not move. Neither does it.

cards.name: Thornspore
cards.flavor: It was always going to be compost. That was the plan.

cards.name: Thornmant
cards.text: Once per turn: move all grown Earth from a friendly unit to this one.
cards.flavor: Nothing is lost. It is only moved somewhere it can still be spent.

attacks.name: Gather
attacks.text: Move all grown Earth from a friendly unit to this one.

cards.name: Bedrock
cards.text: A friendly unit gains +2 Earth permanently.
cards.flavor: Down there it is all one piece.

cards.name: Deep Communion
cards.text: Draw 2 cards. A friendly unit gains +1 Earth permanently.
cards.flavor: Listening is the cheapest way to grow.

cards.name: Terraform
cards.text: Heal 20 to all your units. A friendly unit gains +1 Earth permanently.
cards.flavor: The ground comes back first. It always does.

cards.name: Cairn
cards.text: Permanent: this tower gains +15 max HP.
cards.flavor: One stone, then another, until it means something.

cards.name: Verdant Anchor
cards.text: Attach to a unit. That unit has Earth +2.
cards.flavor: Hold still long enough and the roots decide for you.

cards.name: Rimelit
cards.flavor: It exhales and the grass goes white. Small mercies freeze first.

cards.name: Rimemire
cards.flavor: Grief that learned to keep. Nothing it touches rots -- it simply stops.

cards.name: Gristwisp
cards.flavor: The dust of everything the mill has ever taken. It remembers each one.

cards.name: Gristgaunt

attacks.name: Glean
attacks.text: Return a Hel unit from your discard to your hand

cards.flavor: It separates the living from the dead the way a mill separates chaff.

cards.name: Hollowgrub
cards.flavor: It eats the parts you were not using. You notice much later.

cards.name: Hollowmaw
cards.flavor: A hunger with a body built around it, purely as a convenience.

cards.name: Hollowdrung

attacks.name: Interment
attacks.text: Deal 15 damage to every enemy unit

cards.flavor: It has been digging since before there were things to bury.

cards.name: Osskin
cards.flavor: Bone remembers the shape it held. Given time, it finds it again.

cards.name: Ossshroud
cards.flavor: Every bone it ever wore, worn at once.

cards.name: Ossrend

attacks.name: Exhume
attacks.text: Return a Hel unit from your discard to an empty slot

cards.flavor: It is not raising the dead. It is collecting them.

cards.name: Gnawling
cards.flavor: Too small to fear. That is the arrangement it prefers.

cards.name: Gnawmire
cards.flavor: It has been chewing on the same root for an age and is not bored.

cards.name: Morgrub
cards.flavor: One is nothing. There has never once been one.

cards.name: Sepulwisp
cards.flavor: It mourns whoever strikes it, immediately and at volume.

cards.name: Cairnling
cards.flavor: Every stone was set by someone who wanted to be remembered.

cards.name: Blighthusk
cards.flavor: It is not sick. It is the thing that makes sickness.

cards.name: Blightfen
cards.flavor: The air above it has not moved in a long time.

cards.name: Blightknell

attacks.name: Pestilence
attacks.text: Deal 15 damage to every enemy unit

cards.flavor: Everything downwind of it is already counting down.

cards.name: Tomblit
cards.flavor: Grave-dust with just enough will to drift toward you.

cards.name: Tombshroud
cards.flavor: It has room for one more. It always has room for one more.

cards.name: Tombthane

attacks.name: Grave Call
attacks.text: Return a Hel unit from your discard to an empty slot

cards.flavor: A door that only opens inward.

cards.name: Murklit
cards.flavor: Standing water that has developed opinions.

cards.name: Murkmire
cards.flavor: It does not pull you under. It simply rises.

cards.name: Chargrub
cards.flavor: Still warm. That is the unsettling part.

cards.name: Chargaunt
cards.flavor: What is left when a pyre finishes its work and keeps going.

cards.name: Rotwisp
cards.flavor: Small, patient, and extremely thorough.

cards.name: Rotfen
cards.flavor: It has been working on this field for a season.

cards.name: Grimkin
cards.flavor: It takes every blow personally and returns the favour.

cards.name: Grimshroud
cards.flavor: The ledger balances. It always balances.

cards.name: Ashlit
cards.flavor: The last thing a fire leaves behind, still moving.

cards.name: Ashloam
cards.flavor: It sinks into the soil and comes back as something else.

cards.name: Witherling
cards.flavor: Everything it leans against goes grey.

cards.name: Witherhusk
cards.flavor: It drinks the moisture and leaves the shape.

cards.name: Sepulgrub
cards.flavor: It digs because digging is what there is.

cards.name: Sepulknell
cards.flavor: One long note for everything it has put down.

cards.name: Cairnwisp
cards.flavor: A stack of two stones, technically.

cards.name: Cairnhusk
cards.flavor: Now a stack of nine, and disinclined to move.

cards.name: Morlit
cards.flavor: One of the swarm, separated. It is not coping.

cards.name: Morknell
cards.flavor: It found the others.

cards.name: Gnawhusk
cards.flavor: It has been chewing the same thing for weeks.

cards.name: Gnawloam
cards.flavor: The root finally gave. It has moved on to the tree.

cards.name: Gristlit
cards.flavor: A single stone, turning, with nothing to turn against.

cards.name: Gristfen
cards.flavor: It found something to turn against.

cards.name: Osswisp
cards.flavor: A handful of finger bones with somewhere to be.

cards.name: Ossloam
cards.flavor: It found the rest of itself.

cards.name: Vespermote
cards.flavor: The last light of the day, which is also the first of the reckoning.

cards.name: Vespervigil
cards.flavor: It has kept watch so long that the watching has become the point.

cards.name: Solemim
cards.flavor: It steps in front. That is the entire liturgy.

cards.flavor: A wall that apologises to what it stops.

cards.name: Solemtribune

attacks.text: Restore this unit's Sanctuary at end of turn

cards.name: Clariel

attacks.text: Restore Judgment to every unit you control

cards.name: Aurmote

cards.name: Empyriel
cards.flavor: A shield with a creature attached, roughly in that order.

cards.name: Empyrseraph
cards.flavor: The sky, holding still, on purpose.

cards.name: Cantmote
cards.flavor: A note looking for a chord.

cards.name: Cantlumen
cards.flavor: It found the chord. The chord was a sentence.

cards.name: Vesperkin
cards.flavor: Dusk-light, undecided.

cards.name: Vespercant
cards.flavor: It made up its mind somewhere around midnight.

cards.name: Auriel
cards.flavor: Gilt, and not yet gold.

cards.name: Aurora
cards.flavor: Gold, now, and aware of it.

cards.name: Bellkin
cards.flavor: It has not been struck yet.

cards.name: Bellthrone
cards.flavor: It has been struck. Everyone heard.

cards.name: Clarmote
cards.flavor: Clear light with nothing yet to clarify.

cards.name: Clarseraph
cards.flavor: Now everything in front of it is very obvious.

cards.name: Seramote
cards.flavor: Wings, and no rank to go with them.

cards.name: Seralumen
cards.flavor: It was promoted. The wings multiplied accordingly.

cards.name: Solemkin
cards.flavor: It has taken up a position. Nothing is attacking it yet.

cards.name: Solemthrone
cards.flavor: Something is attacking it now. The position has not moved.

cards.name: Faneith
cards.flavor: It was a temple to something. The something is the part that went.

cards.name: Fanefray
cards.flavor: Worship without an object, running on habit alone.

cards.name: Vastsk
cards.flavor: The distance between two things, given an appetite.

cards.name: Vastebb
cards.flavor: It does not approach. The space in front of it simply gets longer.

cards.name: Vastnought

attacks.name: Engulf
attacks.text: Destroy 2 energy attached to an enemy unit

cards.flavor: Everything that is not it is a rounding error.

cards.name: Scourwane
cards.flavor: Patient as weather and about as negotiable.

cards.name: Scourgaunt
cards.flavor: It takes the surface first. There is rarely anything under it.

cards.name: Hushwane

attacks.name: Quiet
attacks.text: Destroy 1 energy attached to an enemy unit

cards.flavor: It gets between you and the sound of your own thoughts.

cards.name: Hushebb
cards.flavor: Everything is still there. None of it reaches you.

cards.name: Umbrsk
cards.flavor: Not darkness. The place light declined to go.

cards.name: Umbrfray
cards.flavor: The edge of a shadow, which is the hungriest part of it.

cards.name: Umbrreave

attacks.name: Consume Light
attacks.text: Destroy 20% of the enemy's energy pool

cards.flavor: It does not block the light. It keeps it.

cards.name: Nullwane
cards.flavor: It performs one operation and has never needed another.

cards.name: Sevith
cards.flavor: It separates a thing from what made it a thing.

cards.name: Waneith
cards.flavor: Every night it is slightly less, and never quite gone.

cards.name: Lacunith
cards.flavor: A gap in the record where something used to be recorded.

cards.name: Lacunlack
cards.flavor: It removes the word and then the space the word was in.

cards.name: Lacunabyss

attacks.name: Expunge
attacks.text: Destroy 2 energy attached to an enemy unit

cards.flavor: You are certain there was more to this.

cards.name: Gyresk
cards.flavor: It turns, and things near it start turning too.

cards.name: Gyrerift
cards.flavor: The turning has become the only thing there is.

cards.name: Gyreshear

attacks.name: Draw Down
attacks.text: Destroy 20% of the enemy's energy pool

cards.flavor: Past a certain point the turning is no longer optional.

cards.name: Ebonith
cards.flavor: Not dark. Dark is an absence of light; this is a presence.

cards.name: Ebonlack
cards.flavor: It gets into the corners first.

cards.name: Drosssk
cards.flavor: What is left when something is refined and the good part removed.

cards.name: Drossebb
cards.flavor: It is made entirely of what other things discarded.

cards.name: Rivewane
cards.flavor: It finds the seam. There is always a seam.

cards.name: Riveshear
cards.flavor: Two things that used to be one thing.

cards.name: Pallith
cards.flavor: It settles over a thing and the thing stops mattering.

cards.name: Pallgaunt
cards.flavor: You know it is still there. You cannot say why you think so.

cards.name: Starksk
cards.flavor: It takes away everything inessential, which is most things.

cards.name: Starkrift
cards.flavor: What is left is true and almost nothing.

cards.name: Cesssk
cards.flavor: Still water in a place with no outlet.

cards.name: Cessebb
cards.flavor: It found the outlet. The outlet goes down.

cards.name: Nullsk
cards.flavor: It has not decided what to subtract from yet.

cards.name: Nulllack
cards.flavor: It decided.

cards.name: Umbrwane
cards.flavor: A shadow with no object casting it, which nobody has noticed.

cards.name: Umbrabyss
cards.flavor: People have started noticing.

cards.name: Wanesk2
cards.flavor: Every day slightly less of it, and it does not seem to mind.

cards.name: Waneshear
cards.flavor: It has worked out how to do that to other things.

cards.name: Fanewane
cards.flavor: The rite performed correctly, to nobody.

cards.name: Fanerift
cards.flavor: It stopped pretending there was anyone listening.

cards.name: Vastwane
cards.flavor: The distance is normal. It only feels long.

cards.name: Vastabyss
cards.flavor: The distance is no longer normal.

cards.name: Sevsk
cards.flavor: A small cut in something that was supposed to be continuous.

cards.name: Sevlack
cards.flavor: The cut goes all the way through now.

cards.name: Mycelspore
cards.flavor: It is already everywhere. The mushroom is just the part that surfaced.

cards.name: Mycelbough
cards.flavor: It has been quietly connecting the whole grove for years.

cards.name: Granling
cards.flavor: Small, dense, and entirely unbothered.

cards.name: Grancrag
cards.flavor: It does not hurry. It has never once needed to.

cards.name: Granthane
cards.flavor: Mountains are just this, given enough patience.

cards.name: Rootsprout
cards.flavor: Reaching is the only thing it does, and it does it constantly.

cards.name: Rootwarden
cards.flavor: What it holds, it holds on behalf of everything behind it.

cards.name: Thornbud
cards.flavor: Defended out of all proportion to its size.

cards.name: Thorncrag
cards.flavor: Walking into it is a decision you get to make exactly once.

cards.name: Thornheart

attacks.name: Seed the Grove
attacks.text: Move this unit's Earth to another unit you control

cards.flavor: The grove does not end. You simply stop being inside it.

cards.name: Bryospore
cards.flavor: Moss wins every argument by outlasting it.

cards.name: Petriling
cards.flavor: It is becoming stone. It is in no rush about it.

cards.name: Lichbud
cards.flavor: Two things agreeing to be one thing. It has worked so far.

cards.name: Verdspore
cards.flavor: Green comes back. That is the whole of its argument.

cards.name: Ambershoot
cards.flavor: Sap that has decided to become a mineral about it.

cards.name: Amberbole
cards.flavor: Everything it has ever caught is still in there, perfectly.

cards.name: Amberwold

attacks.name: Preserve
attacks.text: Move this unit's Earth to another unit you control

cards.flavor: Time gets in, but it does not get back out.

cards.name: Caldling
cards.flavor: Cooled on the outside. Only on the outside.

cards.name: Caldcrag
cards.flavor: It remembers being liquid and is in no hurry to repeat it.

cards.name: Caldthane
cards.flavor: The mountain that used to be here is inside it now.

cards.name: Fernshoot
cards.flavor: Older than trees, and quietly smug about it.

cards.name: Fernbough
cards.flavor: It has been doing this since before there was anything to watch.

cards.name: Sedgesprout
cards.flavor: Every blade is an edge. There are a great many blades.

cards.name: Sedgefen
cards.flavor: The water is on its side.

cards.name: Loambud
cards.flavor: Good soil, walking. It has opinions about where to settle.

cards.name: Loamwold
cards.flavor: Everything that grows here grows because it allowed it.

cards.name: Burrbud
cards.flavor: It attaches. That is its entire strategy and it works.

cards.name: Burrcrag
cards.flavor: By the time you notice, you have carried it a long way.

cards.name: Tussling
cards.flavor: A hummock of grass that stood up.

cards.name: Tussbole
cards.flavor: It has been in this exact spot for ninety years.

cards.name: Siltsprout
cards.flavor: Fine sediment, going where the water goes.

cards.name: Siltfen
cards.flavor: The water goes where it goes, now.

cards.name: Bryoshoot
cards.flavor: A patch of moss on the shady side.

cards.name: Bryowold
cards.flavor: The shady side is now the entire side.

cards.name: Rootbud
cards.flavor: One root, searching, with no particular plan.

cards.name: Rootbole
cards.flavor: It found water. It found a great deal of water.

cards.name: Verdshoot
cards.flavor: New green, with everything still ahead of it.

cards.name: Verdbole
cards.flavor: Everything ahead of it happened.

cards.name: Petribud
cards.flavor: Soft, but there is something hard under the softness.

cards.name: Petriwold
cards.flavor: The softness has finished being relevant.

cards.name: Lichshoot
cards.flavor: Two organisms, still negotiating.

cards.name: Lichfen
cards.flavor: Negotiations concluded. Both parties are pleased.

cards.name: Thornshoot
cards.flavor: One thorn. It is doing its best.

cards.name: Thornwold
cards.flavor: A great many thorns, all doing their best.
